input_mode: 49 repeated exact t* frames; official Pi3X depth and all-static masks; authored 49-frame C2W rightward 30-degree orbit; source video and rendered point-cloud video
explicit_t_star_input: t* image repeated as video, not numeric timestamp parameter
camera_coordinate_system: Pi3X first-frame C2W; +Z forward, +X right; pivot at median positive first-frame depth
visual_review: 已人工比对原生第0/12/24/36/48帧及t*源帧：踢起的腿从水平伸展明显弯曲回收，头部/躯干姿态改变，故t*冻结失败。背景文字墙与人物相对位置有变化，可能有视角变化，但平面背景/动作漂移使真实30°视差及终点角度无法独立确认；不能认定严格Stage2达标。身份大体保留，末帧与源t*姿态不一致，不能作为严格Stage3拼接端点。

component_review.identity_background: identity mostly recognizable; text wall legible but perspective and shadow change
component_review.stage1_to_stage2_native_seam: source t* and generated first frame resemble but face/head detail and pose differ; not certified continuous
